title: Figure 28: ANSYS 3D geometry mesh of the UAP disc itself
description: ANSYS graphic of the meshed disc-shaped UAP body, an elliptical lens-like disc covered in a quad-dominant surface mesh, with a 6-meter scale bar and axis triad. Caption: 'Solid Three Dimensional Geometry Mesh of UAP Disc.' Part of the CFD model setup in the BAASS UAP analysis capabilities report.
